title: EMIP: Embodied Multi-Party Interaction Platform
abstract: arXiv:2611.29333v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Experimental platforms that enable multiple participants to engage in spoken dialogue and perform physical actions concurrently in a shared environment are important for studying cooperation between humans and embodied AI agents. In this paper, we propose EMIP (Embodied Multi-Party Interaction Platform), a virtual environment platform built on Minecraft. Through an Internet-based client-server architecture, EMIP connects multiple humans and multiple AI agents to the same virtual environment and supports full-duplex speech communication and simultaneous physical interaction. It provides interfaces based on the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for environmental observation, physical action execution, and audio input and output, enabling researchers to develop their own agent control methods using large language models (LLMs). translated_abstract: 能够让多个参与者在共享环境中同时进行口语对话并执行物理动作的实验平台，对于研究人类与具身AI智能体之间的协作非常重要。在本文中，我们提出了EMIP（具身多方交互平台），一个基于Minecraft构建的虚拟环境平台。通过基于互联网的客户端-服务器架构，EMIP将多个人类和多个AI智能体连接到同一虚拟环境中，并支持全双工语音通信和同步物理交互。它提供基于模型上下文协议（MCP）的接口，用于环境观察、物理动作执行以及音频输入和输出，使研究人员能够使用大语言模型（LLM）开发自己的智能体控制方法。其他功能还包括通过单个EMIP智能体客户端对智能体群组进行集中控制、协作对象操作等。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个基于Minecraft构建的具身多方交互平台EMIP，通过客户端-服务器架构支持多个人类与多个AI智能体在同一虚拟环境中进行全双工语音交流和同步物理交互，为研究人类与具身AI智能体之间的协作提供了实验平台。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes EMIP, a Minecraft-based embodied multi-party interaction platform that connects multiple humans and AI agents in a shared virtual environment with full-duplex speech communication and simultaneous physical interaction, providing an experimental platform for studying cooperation between humans and embodied AI agents.
